items.title: Tesla board member Joe Gebbia: Nvidia should “reinstate” Jensen Huang to let investigation play out
items.summary:
Joe Gebbia, the U.S. chief design officer, Airbnb cofounder, and Tesla board member, told Alyson Shontell that Nvidia should reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and then run a due diligence process.

“Nvidia is one of the greatest companies ever of all time, and it got there because of founder mode,” Gebbia said at the F500 Innovation Forum.
